text.text_excerpt: I am a super big FroYo fan! If I know I could eat there everyday, it gets 5 stars. There are so many yogurt places, that one needs to be a little different to reach the 5th star. Frostbite self-serve hits it! Frostbite does change it up a little. They have a "bottoms bar" separate from their "toppings" bar which I love!! They have several items at their "Bottoms bar" such as fresh fruit, full cookies, yogurt raisins, etc. I loved the Red Velvet and Dark chocolate yogurt on the fruit. I then ventured to the "Toppings Bar" where I choose cookie crumbles and chocolate sprinkles with a dollop of Ghirardelli dark chocolate. Delicious! Check it out! They also have seating!

Just went here with my roommates after a yummy lunch at Midway. Sign up for their loyalty program via their Facebook page, it's so worth it! They had a great array of flavors, and a "bottom bar" which I thought was cute and unique. I got vanilla, red velvet cupcake, and cookies and cream. I was lost in a sugar frenzy and finished my 7 oz. cup in about 5 minutes. The lady working (i assume the owner) was very nice. Their toppings selection is OUT OF CONTROL. Better than Yogurtland, better than Pinkberry. I will never go to either of these places again. Why go to a chain when you can support a local business and get the same quality product? This is the best frozen yogurt of all the self-serve places in this city. Their red velvet cake and birthday cake, which conveniently are in the same machine and make a really good combo swirl, are the best!! The consistency and richness are better than the other places. Bottoms bar is genius. The toppings had a great selection. The man who was working was really friendly, too. This is my go-to spot among all the choices.
